claims.quote: Betta rubra is a charismatic and increasingly rare wild betta originating from northern Sumatra, specifically the Aceh region of Indonesia.
Betta rubra is a small labyrinth fish from northwestern Sumatra, Indonesia, known from the Singkil area of Aceh and around Sibolga in North Sumatra.

regions.name: Sumatra
regions.quote: Known only from northwestern Sumatra, Indonesia with definitive records existing from the Singkil area in Aceh province and around Sibolga in North Sumatra (Sumatera Utara) province.
